title: Interior formula for the Gaussian profile
statement: For every $a\in(0,1)$, the closed Gaussian profile at $a$ equals the Gaussian isoperimetric profile at $a$.
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. If $a\in(0,1)$, then $\overline I(a)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(a))$.
